name: Simple Parchment
summary: A message waits for you in the Valley of Trials, sent while you were away. Frang, your class trainer, is outside the Den.

sections.title: A Message from Frang
sections.body: The parchment asks you to read its words and speak with Frang. Your class trainer waits outside the Den in the Valley of Trials.

faq.answer: The parchment appears to have come from Frang, your class trainer.
Frang waits outside the Den in the Valley of Trials.
Frang has words for you when you are ready.

faq.q: What should I do with the parchment?
faq.answer: Read the parchment, then speak with Frang in the Valley of Trials.
